type Handler = (event: string) => void;

type Shape = {
  kind: string;
  area: () => number;
};

interface Greeter {
  greet(name: string): string;
  farewell(name: string): string;
}

declare function externalHelper(x: number): number;

function useHandler(h: Handler, value: string): void {
  if (value.length > 0) {
    h(value);
  }
}

function makeGreeter(): Greeter {
  return {
    greet(name: string): string {
      if (name) {
        return "hello " + name;
      }
      return "hello";
    },
    farewell(name: string): string {
      return "bye " + name;
    },
  };
}

function withGeneric<T, U>(a: T, b: U): boolean {
  return a !== null && b !== null;
}
